name: Sensing Nature: Sight and Sound in Tropical Green Spaces (video / audio rating)
description:
Rebuilt from Hoo, Sidhu & Tan (2026), "Sensing nature in the city: The role of sight and sound in restorative tropical urban green spaces", PLOS ONE 21(6), with the authors' own open stimuli (Tropical Environmental Stimuli Database, OSF doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/4CBYQ, CC BY-NC 4.0).

Each participant is assigned at random to one way of experiencing places: video with sound (bimodal), the same video muted (visual only), or the sound alone (audio only). They then get 30 five-second clips drawn at random from 120 scenes filmed around Johor Bahru and Iskandar Puteri, Malaysia (50 nature, 50 urban, 20 mixed urban-nature), and rate each on perceived naturalness (0 not natural at all to 10 cannot be more natural) and the five items of the Perceived Restorativeness Scale short form (fascination, being away, coherence, scope, compatibility; 0 not at all to 10 completely). Audio participants see the soundscape wording of the same five items (PRS-SF), as in the paper. Scene ids keep the database names: N_ nature, U_ urban, HUHN_ mixed urban-nature. The paper analysed environment × modality with linear mixed models (random intercepts for participant and stimulus).

Differences from the original study: (1) videos are re-encoded to 960 px wide for the web (the paper used the original DSLR clips); (2) the visual-only condition plays the bimodal video muted, which is how the authors made their visual-only clips; (3) the rating questions open after the clip has played once and participants may replay it (the paper played each clip once for five seconds); (4) only age and gender are asked; (5) Qualtrics Loop & Merge is replaced by the page's own random draw. Stimuli are licensed for non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0).

dimensions.label: This place is fascinating; it makes me wonder about things.
This is a place which is away from everyday demands.
This is a place where the activities and the items are ordered and organized.
This is a place which is very large, with no restrictions to movements.
In this place, it is easy to orient and move around so that I could do what I like.

elements.description: One record per clip: key = scene id from the Tropical Environmental Stimuli Database (N_001–N_050 nature, U_001–U_050 urban, HUHN_001–HUHN_020 mixed urban-nature); shown = clips/<id>.mp4 (bimodal and visual; the visual condition plays it muted) or sounds/<id>.mp3 (audio). Values 0–10: naturalness (0 not natural at all, 10 cannot be more natural) and the PR-SF items (0 not at all, 10 completely). Audio participants see the PRS-SF soundscape wording of the same five items.
